snippet.title: Livly Island PV - Your New Livly Is Waiting!
snippet.description:
Over 5 million app downloads worldwide!
On Livly Island, you assume the form of a "hom" to care for mysterious creatures born from alchemy called "livlies" , dress up in fun outfits, and decorate your island to your liking.

Enjoy life with livlies on your smartphone! 

Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Livlyisland.en/
Official Home Page: https://www.livly.com
Official Instagram: @livlyisland
Download Here: https://app.adjust.com/uh4cwat
